statement: The best open-weight model reaches the frontier score of 6 months earlier (Epoch Capabilities Index; rolling, 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Condition held for most of 2026 on Epoch's soft (statistical-tie) definition: average open-closed lag ~4 months (8 ECI points) Jan-May 2026; lag stays within 1-8 months since mid-2024. Under a strict point-estimate definition the lag is ~6 months - borderline. Cyber-specific lag is 6-7 months. Open-weight frontier is led by Bloc B developers.

items.summary: A Bloc B open-weight model became the first downloadable model to pass the index's 150 anchor point (set by a Bloc A model released ~8 months earlier).
items.detail: Z.ai GLM-5.1, ECI ~150.7 (April 2026), vs GPT-5 = 150 (Aug 2025). Exponential Tracker compilation of Epoch ECI; release day approximate.

items.summary: Epoch AI: since January 2026 the most capable open-weight models lagged frontier closed models by an average of 4 months (8 ECI points, 90% CI 7-11), slightly wider than the 3-month average for 2023-Oct 2025; ~6 months under a strict-dominance definition. Epoch says the true gap is likely understated.
items.detail: Epoch Data Insight 'Open models lag state-of-the-art closed models by 4 months' (Edwards & Emberson).

items.summary: A Bloc B open-weight release closed to within 5.6 ECI points of the standing closed record (a Bloc A model from June 2026), under a non-commercial licence.
items.detail: Moonshot Kimi K3, ECI 158.6 vs Claude Fable 5 (Exponential Tracker from Epoch ECI).

items.summary: Two Bloc A closed records in September 2026 reopened the open-closed gap to ~10.4 ECI points (sawtooth pattern: widening on closed releases, collapsing on open ones).
items.detail: Claude Fable 5.1 (2026-09-01) and GPT-6 Astra (2026-09-03); Exponential Tracker.

items.summary: Epoch AI: on a cybersecurity-specific index the best open-weight model (Bloc B) scores where the closed frontier stood 6-7 months earlier - just outside the 6-month bar for that domain.
items.detail: Epoch Data Insight 'Open-weight models trail closed models in cyber capabilities by 6-7 months': GLM-5.3 Cyber ECI 160 vs Claude Opus 5.5 / GPT-6 Astra 171. (Another analysis labels GLM-5.3 closed weights.)

items.summary: Best open-weight model reached ECI ~161.4 (Bloc B, Oct 2026), ~7.6 points below the closed frontier at release - roughly the closed frontier level of ~4-6 months earlier. Index refits can revise history.
items.detail: Moonshot Kimi K3.1 Pro 161.37; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 159.4. Exponential Tracker (Epoch ECI; Nov 2026 refit). Release day approximate.
